## Gap ID
API-002

## Source
gap-analysis-api-interface

## Description
OSimFlow has no measure management API. There is no endpoint to discover, inspect, or manage measures in a campaign.

openstudio-server provides full measure management via its API.

## Evidence
- `osimflow/api/` — no measure endpoints
- Measures only accessible via filesystem
- No measure argument introspection API

## Severity
Major

## Recommended Mitigation
Add a `/api/v1/measures` router with discovery and introspection endpoints. This depends on EXT-012 (MeasureRegistry).

## Labels
gap-analysis, api, measures, major
